title: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, Vision of the Son of Man

questions.question: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things that must soon take place. He made it known by sending his ____ to his servant John,
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:1 (ESV): "The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things that must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,"

questions.question: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who ____, and who keep what is written in it, for the time is near.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:3 (ESV): "Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear, and who keep what is written in it, for the time is near."

questions.question: John to the seven churches that are in ____: Grace to you and peace from him who is and who was and who is to come,
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:4 (ESV): "John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from him who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven spirits who are before his throne,"

questions.question: and from the seven ____ who are before his throne,
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:4 (ESV): "...and from the seven spirits who are before his throne,"

questions.question: and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness, the ____ of the dead, and the ruler of kings on earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:5 (ESV): "and from Jesus Christ the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of kings on earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood"

questions.question: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every ____ will see him, even those who pierced him,
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:7 (ESV): "Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him, and all tribes of the earth will wail on account of him. Even so. Amen."

questions.question: "I am the Alpha and the ____," says the Lord God, "who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty."
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:8 (ESV): "'I am the Alpha and the Omega,' says the Lord God, 'who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.'"

questions.question: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and the kingdom and the patient endurance that are in Jesus, was on the island called ____ on account of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:9 (ESV): "I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and the kingdom and the patient endurance that are in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos on account of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus."

questions.question: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a ____
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:10 (ESV): "I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet"

questions.question: Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches, to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:11 (ESV): "saying, 'Write what you see in a book and send it to the seven churches, to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamum and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.'"

questions.question: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me, and on turning I saw seven golden ____,
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:12 (ESV): "Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking to me, and on turning I saw seven golden lampstands,"

questions.question: and in the midst of the lampstands one like a son of man, clothed with a long robe and with a golden ____ around his chest.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:13 (ESV): "and in the midst of the lampstands one like a son of man, clothed with a long robe and with a golden sash around his chest."

questions.question: The hairs of his head were white, like white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a ____ of fire,
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:14 (ESV): "The hairs of his head were white, like white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire,"

questions.question: In his right hand he held seven ____, from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like the sun shining in full strength.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:16 (ESV): "In his right hand he held seven stars, from his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword, and his face was like the sun shining in full strength."

questions.question: As for the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand... the seven stars are the ____ of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:20 (ESV): "As for the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands, the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches."

key_verse_text: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty."
